title: Add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts and docs updates
author: Priya Kapoor
commits: Init: add RAG/agent quickstart scaffold and examples

description: Context: Add first-class quickstarts and example templates for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent/tool-calling flows. Motivation: provide engineers a short, copy-pasteable path to evaluate RAG and agents with Redwood (hosted and private) and to reduce onboarding friction for model + retriever + tool patterns. What this PR does: 1) Adds a set of opinionated RAG templates (prompt + retriever wiring + eval prompts) under redwood-examples/rag-templates; 2) Adds agent/tool-calling quickstarts for Python and TypeScript showing a) tool registration with the Redwood API, b) structured function/tool calling patterns, c) safe fallback behavior and streaming examples under redwood-examples/agents; 3) Adds docs site pages and navigation entries in redwood-docs/docs/quickstarts to surface the examples and link to runnable sandboxes; 4) Adds CI coverage: example smoke tests and lightweight runner tests that execute mocked retriever/tool calls; 5) Updates README and contributing notes for running examples locally and under Redwood Private. Checklist: - [x] Examples added (python + ts) - [x] Docs pages with step-by-step quickstarts - [x] CI smoke tests (unit/mocked) - [x] Links from main quickstarts index - [x] Example license/attribution notes - [x] Performance note: small (no runtime impact on serving runtime) Usage notes and intent: the RAG templates include canonical prompt templates (user + context + citations) and a small eval prompt set for regression checks. The agent examples demonstrate function/tool schemas, ambiguous input handling, and how to combine tools with a retriever in a single orchestration. Compatibility: examples are written to be compatible with both hosted Redwood API and the private deployment SDKs; instructions include environment variable examples and a troubleshooting section. Testing: added pytest-based smoke test for python examples and a node-based integration test that runs in CI with mocked HTTP calls to avoid network dependencies. CI matrix: new example tests run on ubuntu-latest python 3.10 / node 18. Docs: mkdocs sidebars updated, new quickstart pages added, and cross-links to SDK docs and the model catalog. Files changed: list below. Related work: follows on the RAG agent quickstart series (see pr-18321, pr-18402, pr-18606) and Linear ENG-2345. Known limitations: examples rely on a small local vectorstore adapter (provided) which is not intended for production; we link to the recommended prod connectors. Migration/upgrade notes: none needed. Merge plan: squash and merge after approvals and CI green.
